entities.summary: Joan Trimble was an Irish composer and pianist from Ulster. She studied at the Royal Irish Academy of Music and the Royal College of Music in London, and she and her sister performed for many years as a piano duo. In later years she inherited her father's newspaper, becoming its proprietor and editor.
